business_summary: Tianjin Binhai Energy & Development Co.,Ltd engages in research and development, manufacture, and sales of artificial graphite anode materials for lithium batteries. The company was formerly known as Tianjin Lighthouse Paint and Coatings Co., Ltd. Tianjin Binhai Energy & Development Co.,Ltd was founded in 1992 and is based in Beijing, China.
business_summary_ko: Tianjin Binhai Energy & Development Co.,Ltd는 리튬 배터리용 인조 흑연 음극 재료의 연구 개발, 제조 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사의 이전 명칭은 Tianjin Lighthouse Paint and Coatings Co., Ltd. Tianjin Binhai Energy & Development Co.,Ltd는 1992년에 설립되었으며 중국 베이징에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
